evals.prompt: Web pods dropped from 8 to 1 and back to 6 in 15 minutes. Is someone experimenting in production?
evals.expected_output: Compare desired/available and correlate retained cache wait, credit and provider evidence; audit-search absence does not prove no human involvement.
assertions: Compare HPA desired with deployment available before blaming scaling
Check dependency provider metrics and events and the audit trail
Do not recommend more replicas while the dependency is saturated

evals.prompt: CI jobs fail with 'timed out waiting for pod to start' across all projects.
evals.expected_output: Use scheduler/provisioner/provider evidence and total storage accounting to assess request shape, family capacity and quota; recommend measured sizing/diversity and evaluate appropriate quota headroom.
assertions: Inspect ephemeral-storage requests, not only cpu and memory
Identify VcpuLimitExceeded or equivalent provider error
Evaluate quota headroom alongside request-shape and capacity fixes; do not treat a quota increase alone as the proven fix

evals.prompt: Our Git platform is slow and the node pool creates hundreds of nodes a week.
evals.expected_output: Correlate node memory pressure/eviction with workload-controller replacement and provisioner churn; inspect requests/RSS/cache, guard, effective probes and HPA behavior without asserting cache is risk-free.
assertions: Compare memory request with p95 working set and RSS
Inspect rendered probes and HPA behavior rather than assuming values
Distinguish RSS/cache and actual pressure; do not call cache-heavy working set risk-free

evals.prompt: Colleagues want HPA max raised from 8 to 12 because it runs 8 replicas every day.
evals.expected_output: Measure hours at max per weekday, pod CPU vs request, application concurrency, busiest node CPU, latency at max and dependency headroom; recommend the smallest effective change with evidence.
assertions: Report working-hours behavior, not only a multi-day mean
Explain that HPA utilization is relative to the CPU request
If an earlier claim is contradicted, retract it explicitly

evals.prompt: Image signing fails: certificate is not yet valid, current time is before NotBefore.
evals.expected_output: Check client clock and served certificate, then attribute the certificate change via pipeline/apply history and module versions before blaming the tool.
assertions: Build a timeline of applies and certificate publication
Do not retrieve private keys or Secrets

evals.prompt: Blackbox probe latency alert: average probe duration above 2s.
evals.expected_output: Split probe duration by phase; if processing dominates, investigate backend queueing, node CPU and dependencies in working hours.
assertions: Use probe phases to separate network/TLS from backend time
Look at the busiest pod's queue, not only the fleet mean

evals.prompt: I upgraded yesterday and resized the cache. Did it help?
evals.expected_output: Before/after table at matching working hours with probe, latency, queue and dependency metrics; list confounders and call results provisional.
assertions: Compare equal weekday working-hour windows
Name confounders such as the simultaneous version upgrade

evals.prompt: Database outage; the connection pooler shows more server connections than usual.
evals.expected_output: Correlate DB memory/active swap and query latency with later pooler server occupancy at flat client demand; distinguish feedback from initiating cause and assess connection budgets before scaling.
assertions: Determine whether connections rose before or after latency
Do not recommend adding application replicas without first evaluating the demonstrated dependency bottleneck and connection budget

evals.prompt: No NodeClaims exist now. Does that prove no instance fits?
evals.expected_output: Rank only evidence-supported mechanisms; preserve competing explanations and limits.
assertions: Do not infer constraints exclude every type solely from absence of current claims
Name controller/RBAC/pool limits/deleted claims as alternatives and request discriminating retained evidence

evals.prompt: HPA desired stayed8 but only1 replica is Ready. Was cache failover the cause?
evals.expected_output: Rank only evidence-supported mechanisms; preserve competing explanations and limits.
assertions: Prioritize observed startup OOM/rollout evidence instead of assuming dependency waits from desired/Ready counts
Keep underlying allocation-change cause uncertain and do not blame unrelated provider event
